notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Basal Sliver.
description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Basal Sliver dies, triggering Salvaging Station and Kaya's Ghostform.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Basal Sliver from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Basal Sliver.
Repeat.
